name: Shaanxi Energy Investment
summary: Shaanxi Energy Investment Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise primarily engaged in the generation of thermal electricity and the extraction of coal. The company also produces and supplies heat. It commands a significant total installed power capacity of 11.18 million kilowatts. Established in 2003, Shaanxi Energy Investment has its headquarters in Xi'an, China, and functions as a subsidiary of Shaanxi Investment Group Co., Ltd.
